title: Policy-gated plan rescoring with automated remediation hints for Private VPC IaC
creator: Asha Mehta
description: Improve Terraform CI pipeline for Private (VPC) deployments by adding a policy-aware plan rescoring step and surfacing automated remediation hints in PRs. Goal is to reduce manual triage time for policy failures, enable quicker safe rollouts, and standardize plan gating using OPA/Conftest rulesets.
background: Current preflight pipeline runs `terraform plan` and then a Conftest/OPA evaluation which returns a binary pass/fail with a block comment on the PR. Customers and platform engineers frequently need context about why a plan was scored as high-risk and what minimal changes would remediate the issue. We also lack a normalized numeric score for plans that can feed into observability and canary gate decisions.
technical_design: 1) Add a plan rescoring service in the CI job that aggregates multiple policy evaluations (safety, networking, IAM, resource-count) into a normalized risk score (0-100). 2) Extend our Conftest rules with metadata tags (severity, quick-fix-snippet) and use those to compile remediation hints. 3) CI job will post a structured PR comment summarizing score, top 3 failing rules with remediation snippets, and suggested action (block/warn/auto-accept with human approval). 4) Persist metrics to the Infra Observability workspace: plan.score, policy.fail.count, remediation-suggested.count. 5) Provide an opt-in route for automated minor remediations (terraform fmt, resource tags, size limits) behind a feature flag and audit log.
acceptance_criteria: CI displays a normalized plan risk score for every terraform plan in private/vpc repos
Top 3 policy failures surfaced as human-readable remediation hints in PR comments
Conftest/OPA rules include quick-fix snippets for >= 60% of common failure cases
Telemetry emitted for plan.score and policy failure breakdowns to Grafana/Prometheus
Optional 'suggested-fix' flow provides an automated PR with minor remediation for non-invasive fixes and logs audit events
implementation_tasks: Design plan scoring schema and weight table for rule categories
Update Conftest rule library to include metadata: severity, category, quick_fix_snippet
Implement CI step `plan-rescorer` as a standalone containerized tool (Go) that calls conftest, computes score, and formats PR comment payload
Add inspector CLI to generate suggested terraform diffs for trivial fixes (formatting, tag additions, sizing) guarded by feature flag
Add metrics emission to telemetry pipeline and dashboards in infra-observability (create grafana panels)
Integration tests: mock plans that trigger specific rules and assert score and comment content
Write runbook for platform SREs covering gating thresholds and rollback process
Ship initial rollout to private/vpc repos behind feature flag and run in monitor-only mode for 2 weeks

risks: False positives may block valid changes if weights are too aggressive
Quick-fix snippets could introduce drift if not validated against module invariants
Increased CI job time due to extra rescoring step could slow developer feedback loops
Storing remediation suggestions or automated PRs could surface sensitive infra details if not redacted
rollback_plan: Revert CI job change or disable feature flag to stop rescoring
Remove access to automated remediation bot and close its PRs if issues discovered
Backfill telemetry to identify any blocked deploys during feature window and engage on-call infra SRE
qa_plan: Unit tests for scoring logic with boundary cases (0, 50, 100)
Integration tests that run on sample private/vpc terraform plans and validate PR comment format
Security review of quick-fix snippets to ensure no secrets or account ids are leaked
Canary rollout: enable monitor-only in 10 repos, then enable suggest-fix in 3 internal repos, then open rollout
notes: This ticket builds on existing Conftest/OPA policy investments but focuses on developer experience and operability
Follow-on work: automatic retreat-to-safe-variant routing when plan.score > threshold (future ticket)
Coordinate with PM and Design for PR comment UX so suggestions are actionable without noise
